consent.title: Let's start with what you need.
consent.ledeApp: I can check where customer projects stand, explain menus, summarize your finances, and draft messages from your own business data.
consent.ledePublic: I can explain Satu Alur, its plans and pricing, and how to get started.
consent.point1: Waguri answers one thing per turn, so ask one question at a time.
consent.point2: Waguri can point you to the right page or data to open.
consent.point3: You can close or clear the chat at any time.
consent.note: Chat history is stored on this device only.
consent.noteQuota: AI answers use your AI Advisor quota.
